nodes.label: DeepSeek-v4-Pro

nodes.label: Hermes Agent
nodes.description: Nous Research Hermes — underlying agent framework

nodes.label: File Server
nodes.description: File delivery system: localhost:8890, bot auto-detects and delivers to correct chat

nodes.label: Memory System
nodes.description: Dual-mode memory: injected (Hermes blocks) or self-sufficient (read from files). MEMORY.md + USER.md with § separator.

nodes.label: Skills System
nodes.description: Agent skills management: skill_view, skill_manage (create/patch/edit/delete), list. Preloaded via <available_skills> block.

nodes.label: People Lookup
nodes.description: Multi-source people search: tg-cli → himalaya → Apple Notes → Obsidian

nodes.label: Telegram Markdown Formatting
nodes.description: Rich Telegram formatting: tables, lists, headers, task lists, code blocks

nodes.label: Language Adaptation
nodes.description: Multi-language response routing based on [LANG] tag: RU, EN, FR, DE, ES, ZH

nodes.label: OpenRouter Fallback
nodes.description: Hermes 4 70B via OpenRouter API as fallback when DeepSeek blocks at token level

nodes.label: Mid-Turn Steering
nodes.description: Human-in-the-loop: adjust course immediately on mid-response user directives

links.rationale: Both are knowledge management subsystems for the agent
